description: Get The Standard Reserve (TSR)'s exit-pressure reading on Robinhood Chain and the resolution (exit) fee rate it produces. Exit pressure is the reserve's own accumulated exit activity, decayed toward zero over time, not a queue of pending redemptions; read it against the active policy (call 1s_std_policy_current for that context). Pass history_hours to get the history series instead of the latest snapshot, or atBlock to get the raw snapshot at or before that block (ignored when history_hours is set; the live fee-rate recompute only runs for the current row, not a historical one). Fields ending in _raw are 18-decimal integers as strings. Divide by 1e18 to get token amounts. exit_pressure_now_raw is the exact value. exit_pressure_now is the same number as a float, kept for older clients.

atBlock.description: Return the raw exit-pressure snapshot at or before this block instead of the latest one

history_hours.description: When set, return exit-pressure history for this many hours instead of the current snapshot

name: 1s_std_exit_pressure
title: TSR Exit Pressure
